component_name: Reproducible specifications and institutional release review
title: Reproducible candidate identity
requirement: Identify the exact candidate artifacts used to assess Reproducible specifications and institutional release review: specifications, executable code or model where applicable, configuration, and fixture versions.
verification_procedure: Record artifact digests and declared build or analysis inputs; reproduce the relevant artifact or explain nondeterministic outputs with a stable verification target.
pass_criteria: Another reviewer can identify the same candidate. Document-only or analytical evidence is labeled as such and does not imply a working implementation.
accountable_owner_role: Independent architecture, security, research, and release reviewers
independent_reviewer_role: Independent technical verifier; domain specialist where applicable
applicability_rule: Assess when BVE-C136 is selected and the stated surface exists; otherwise require an approved, reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE decision. Missing specification, unavailable evidence, or a failed test is not non-applicability.

provenance.source_role: Context for the mechanism; not evidence that this control is source-prescribed, implemented, or passed.
